description: Subscribe a business to RepuTend from the conversation: the Stripe Checkout link to show the person, and next_step, what happens after paying, to tell them. Ask the person which plan they want (Standard or Contingency; a call without plan and email answers plan_needed with both plans, what sets each apart, and existing_account, the sentence for a person whose business already has or had a RepuTend account, who writes to support instead of paying) and the email address that will own the account, then call with profile (the business's domain or its Trustpilot profile address), plan and email. Every business gets a link, and the payment decides: the first payment for a business without a RepuTend account makes its payer the account's owner, and a payment that can start no account is cancelled and refunded, and its payer told by email. If RepuTend already agreed a plan for the business, the link is on that plan. billing_not_enabled until billing starts. (capability: access.request)
name: get_checkout_link
